name: Eleanor Vance
bio:
Eleanor's passion for motorsport ignited at a young age, fueled by her father's stories of his racing days and countless hours spent tinkering with go-karts in the garage. She excelled in her mechanical engineering studies, graduating top of her class before landing a coveted internship with a Formula 3 team. There, she honed her skills in data analysis, vehicle dynamics, and powertrain optimization, quickly proving her worth and earning a full-time position.

After several successful seasons in F3, Eleanor sought a new challenge and joined the Caterham Academy. As Chief Engineer, she is responsible for overseeing the technical development of the team's cars, managing a team of engineers and technicians, and ensuring that the cars are performing at their peak on race day. She is known for her meticulous attention to detail, her ability to quickly diagnose and solve problems, and her unwavering commitment to innovation. Eleanor is driven by a desire to push the boundaries of what's possible and to help her team achieve victory.

What sets Eleanor apart is her talent for seeing the big picture. She understands that success in motorsport requires not only technical expertise but also strong teamwork, effective communication, and a relentless focus on continuous improvement. She fosters a collaborative environment within her team, encouraging open communication and creative problem-solving.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Eleanor has a slender build and a focused intensity in her eyes.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of 'Engineering Formulas' in her backpack.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of Earl Grey tea in the garage during race weekends.
